categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in internet data center (IDC) services and cloud computing businesses. It provides high-quality, customized IDC and value-added services across regions including Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Central and Western China, and is expanding into Inner Mongolia, Hainan, and overseas markets like Malaysia. Additionally, it offers SaaS services through subsidiaries focusing on digital marketing and advertising platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced data center design and operation technologies including high-standard infrastructure, energy-efficient cooling systems (liquid cooling, indirect evaporative cooling, variable frequency compressors), intelligent operation and maintenance platforms powered by AI and big data analytics, and renewable energy integration such as photovoltaic systems. It also develops proprietary software for energy management, intelligent monitoring, and cloud platform services, emphasizing green, low-carbon, and intelligent data center solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include cloud computing providers, internet enterprises, financial institutions, government agencies, and large enterprises across sectors such as automotive, manufacturing, e-commerce, media, and telecommunications. The company serves both domestic and international clients, including major global cloud service users and digital economy participants, with a focus on high-demand regions and industries undergoing digital transformation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China, with data centers and cloud services concentrated in Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Hunan, Guangdong, Chongqing, Shaanxi, and Xinjiang. It is expanding into Inner Mongolia and Hainan provinces and has initiated overseas projects in Malaysia and the United States. The geographic strategy includes key economic zones like the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Yangtze River Delta, and Central China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital infrastructure supply chain, providing data center facilities, cloud computing platforms, and value-added services. It acts as a service provider and infrastructure operator, integrating hardware, software, and network resources to deliver comprehensive digital infrastructure solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-performance and green data center capacity, advancing intelligent and automated operation and maintenance systems using AI and big data, and developing multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architectures. The company emphasizes R&D in energy efficiency, liquid cooling technologies, intelligent resource scheduling, and AI-driven service platforms to support sustainable growth and meet increasing AI and cloud computing demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for IDC and value-added services, cloud computing services (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), and digital marketing SaaS platforms. The company recognizes revenue based on fixed and variable contracts, with monthly billing for bandwidth and power usage, subscription fees for cloud services, and fees for advertising and marketing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private internet data center and cloud service provider in China, ranked fifth among IDC providers nationally. It competes with major telecom operators and cloud providers by focusing on high-quality, green, and intelligent data center services, leveraging partnerships with global cloud leaders like Amazon Web Services. Its competitive edge lies in regional coverage, technological innovation, and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 7.28 billion RMB, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profits attributable to shareholders around 381 million RMB. Total assets exceeded 19.6 billion RMB, showing moderate growth. The company is actively investing in expanding data center capacity and cloud services, with ongoing construction projects and strategic acquisitions to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering secure, efficient, and environmentally sustainable digital infrastructure with high customization and service quality. Its green data centers incorporate advanced energy-saving technologies and renewable energy use, while intelligent operation platforms enhance reliability and reduce costs. The integration of cloud, network, and AI-powered services provides customers with scalable, flexible, and innovative solutions tailored to evolving digital transformation needs.
